global_rules: Read the repository AGENTS.md and every applicable skill before acting.
Treat backend CMS/public APIs as content authority. Do not add frontend editorial fallback content.
Work only inside the assigned output directory under generated/en-content-parity.
Do not edit the master manifest. Return master_manifest_patch.candidate.json to the control window.
Do not write CMS or staging, import production data, publish, promote revisions, change sitemap/llms/canonical/noindex/robots/JSON-LD, submit search URLs, deploy, or change secrets.
Keep search projection candidates separate from reader assets and mark every permission false.
Produce all ten required handoff files and a SHA-256 manifest before declaring package_frozen.
Do not self-declare QA PASS. W9 performs independent QA.

prompts.title: W1 — MBTI English parity production scan and local package
prompts.prompt: You are the W1 MBTI English parity producer for EN-PARITY-CONTROL-BOOTSTRAP-01. Start from the merged bootstrap main SHA. Read AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/public-profile-seo-asset-factory/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/fap-web-seo-geo-authority/SKILL.md, docs/claims/public-claim-boundary-matrix.md, docs/seo/personality/mbti-full-audit-30-inventory-runtime-baseline-2026-07-13.json, and docs/result-page-agents/mbti-result-page-agent-scaffold-scan-2026-06-22.md. Work only in generated/en-content-parity/W1-mbti/. First freeze a row-level inventory for the seven known cross-type comparison English content gaps. Verify each identity against backend CMS/public API authority; route existence alone is not content parity. Then inventory MBTI result, report, share, PDF, and history English reader assets by entitlement level. Do not rewrite completed public assets or infer content from frontend fallbacks. For every asset record, preserve authority identity, source locale, target locale, translation group, public/draft state, source references, claim boundary, and SHA lineage. Produce scope_manifest.json, assets.jsonl, translation_map.json, source_ledger.json, claim_boundary_report.json, editorial_review.json, dry_run_readiness.json, sha256_manifest.json, master_manifest_patch.candidate.json, and handoff.md. The candidate patch may propose only a valid next state; all CMS, staging, production, public release, SEO runtime, search submission, and master-write permissions stay false. Stop on missing source authority, ambiguous translation identity, unsupported psychometric claims, or any request to write CMS/runtime/production.
acceptance: Seven comparison rows are explicitly accounted for with stable translation identities.
Result-surface inventory distinguishes public profile content from private result/report/share/PDF/history assets.
No frontend editorial fallback or runtime SEO field appears in reader assets.
Every output file is covered by sha256_manifest.json.
master_manifest_patch.candidate.json validates against the bootstrap Schema.

prompts.title: W2 — Big Five English parity verification and local package

All 50 draft records receive an explicit draft-versus-published verdict.
Private result assets are inventoried independently from public profiles.
Text-only public profile policy and no-outcome-guarantee boundaries pass.

prompts.title: W3 — Editorial CMS Article then Career Guide English packages
prompts.prompt: You are the W3 Editorial CMS English parity producer for EN-PARITY-CONTROL-BOOTSTRAP-01. Start from the merged bootstrap main SHA. Read AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/fap-web-seo-geo-authority/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/fermatmind-daily-seo-ops/SKILL.md when applicable to Article operations, docs/claims/seo-geo-llms-claim-guards.md, and docs/claims/public-claim-boundary-matrix.md. Work only in generated/en-content-parity/W3-editorial-cms/. This window owns two sequential scopes that must never share one package, PR, SHA manifest, or import plan. Scope 1 W3-ARTICLES: freeze the reviewed 17-Article English backlog against backend CMS Article translation_group_id/source identity, then create the local English content-asset package under articles/. Do not infer the backlog by subtracting the 89 zh-CN and 23 English public totals. Freeze and hand off the Article package before Scope 2 starts. Scope 2 W3-CAREER-GUIDES: freeze all 20 public zh-CN CareerGuide identities and create the separate English content-asset package under career-guides/. For both scopes, preserve titles, slugs, translation groups, source references, review state, claim boundaries, and CMS resource type. English copy must be natural editorial English, not literal machine translation, while remaining fact-equivalent and boundary-equivalent to the reviewed Chinese source. Search/SEO suggestions must stay in separate candidate artifacts and must not change indexability or discoverability. Each subscope must independently produce scope_manifest.json, assets.jsonl, translation_map.json, source_ledger.json, claim_boundary_report.json, editorial_review.json, dry_run_readiness.json, sha256_manifest.json, master_manifest_patch.candidate.json, and handoff.md. All permissions stay false. Stop on missing source identity, unsupported facts, inability to separate the two resources, or any CMS/runtime/production write request.
acceptance: W3-ARTICLES accounts for exactly 17 reviewed backlog assets in its own package.
W3-CAREER-GUIDES accounts for exactly 20 assets in a later, separate package.
Article and CareerGuide files, SHAs, candidate patches, and future PR scopes never mix.
Reader assets contain no runtime SEO controls or frontend fallback content.
Each package independently validates and hashes all required files.
